exactSourceSemantics.idle: activeTransfers.get()==0 && sockets.isEmpty(). False proves at least one predicate was false at that instant; actual split/count is unknown.
exactSourceSemantics.accept: Accepted application socket and actual PG socket are registered before target connection/transfer. Two opaque copy tasks each increment activeTransfers before submit. Submission rejection decrements its own count and closes tracked sockets through existing catch.
exactSourceSemantics.transfer: Each original copy task finally erases its own byte buffer, closes both sides, then decrements activeTransfers. Another transfer can still be unwinding after its peer closes both sockets.
exactSourceSemantics.closeSocket: A socket is removed from the tracked set only when actual socket.isClosed. Close failure is queued; failed unclosed ownership is not removed.
exactSourceSemantics.lifecycleDistinction: Driver/JDBC query completion and real sender/confirmation transaction return establish their own operation/resource cleanup. They do not synchronously execute the independent proxy copy task finalizers. Bridge termination/elapsed time alone cannot substitute for actual owner completion.
